title: Weapons And Tools By Jesse
description: This mod is still in beta, but for now it adds a emerald pickaxe and armor.
body:
# Weapons And Tools By Jesse (BETA)
Welcome to the early stages of this mod. This project is currently in Beta, which means it is a work in progress and I am actively working on adding more features and refining the gameplay.

# Current Features
This mod introduces new utility items for Emeralds to enhance your gear:

Emerald Armor Set: A full set of high-tier protection.

Emerald Pickaxe: A durable and efficient mining tool.

Sunglasses: A unique accessory for your character.

# Feedback and Bug Reports
Since this is a Beta version, you may encounter some issues. Your feedback is essential for the development of this mod.

Important: Please report any bugs you find in the comments section or via the issues tracker. Providing details about the bug helps me fix it much faster.
